title: 事象の地平線における継承 ―エントロピーのゆらぎと観測者の残響―
author: 七海 シグマ

en.title: Inheritance at the Event Horizon: Entropy Fluctuations and the Observer's Echoes
en.premise: When Elias transformed himself into the ultimate noise, the memories of vanished civilizations began to circulate through the universe as waves of information. Kaeris, a new kind of pilgrim who treats memory as physical mass, wanders in search of fragments of a former partner. However, in the far reaches of the galaxy, a gravitationally isolated information storage layer—resembling vast undersea ruins—begins to vibrate abnormally, threatening to re-fix the causality of the entire universe. There, Kaeris discovers a fragment of an incomplete yet indomitable will, like a broken sword left behind.

zh.title: 事件视界中的继承 ——熵之涨落与观测者的残响——
zh.premise: 随着埃利亚斯将自身转化为终极噪声，消逝文明的记忆化作信息的波动，在宇宙中循环往复。卡埃里斯作为一名将记忆视为物理质量的新型“巡礼者”，在旅途中追寻着昔日伙伴的碎片。然而，在银河边缘一座重力孤立、宛如“海底遗迹”般的巨大信息存储层中，一场试图重新固定全宇宙因果律的异常震动悄然开启。在那里，卡埃里斯发现了一块如同“折断之剑”般，虽不完整却意志坚定的碎片。
